leads.title: Law of Georgia on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination
leads.documents: Bans all forms of discrimination including sexual orientation, gender identity and expression; Article 1 quoted as ensuring equal enjoyment of rights.
leads.detail: Adopted 2 May 2014, took effect on publication 7 May 2014; Georgian title: diskriminatsiis qvela pormis aghmopkhvris shesakheb; No URL visible in text

leads.title: Criminal Code of Georgia - Article 53 (amended since 2012)
leads.documents: Makes crimes committed on grounds of sexual orientation or gender identity an aggravating factor resulting in tougher sentences.
leads.detail: Cited as 'article 53 of the Criminal Code'; in force since 2012; No URL visible in text

leads.title: Labor Code of Georgia - Article 2(3)
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination on basis of sexual orientation in employment relations since 2006.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Article 2(3) of the Labor Code'; No URL visible in text

leads.title: Constitution of Georgia - 2017 reform, in effect 2018
leads.documents: Defines marriage solely as 'a union between a woman and a man for the purpose of creating a family', blocking same-sex marriage.
leads.detail: Passed 26 Sept 2017, went into effect after 2018 presidential election / inauguration 16 Dec 2018; requires 3/4 (113 MPs); No URL visible

leads.title: Georgian Penal Code Articles 140 and 141 + 2000 amended criminal code
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex sexual activity and sets equal age of consent at 16 for hetero- and homosexual sex to meet Council of Europe / ECHR standards.
leads.detail: Freedom of same-sex activity enshrined 2000; age of consent 16 per articles 140 and 141; No URL visible

leads.title: Constitutional Court of Georgia rulings on blood donation - 4 Feb 2014 and July 2017
leads.documents: Declared ban on gay/bisexual men donating blood unconstitutional; 2017 ruling notes modern HIV/AIDS detection makes ban unnecessary.
leads.detail: 2014 ban wording was homosexuality as restricting factor, then changed to 'men who have sex with men'; July 2017 lifted ban; No URL visible

leads.title: Legislative package 'On Family Values and Protection of Minors' - Parliament of Georgia
leads.documents: 2024 anti-LGBT law banning 'LGBTQ propaganda', pride events/rainbow flag, gender reassignment surgery/interventions, gender marker change, adoption by non-heterosexuals, media broadcast of same-sex relations.
leads.detail: Initiated 4 June 2024 by Speaker Shalva Papuashvili; passed first reading 27 June 2024, second 4 Sept 2024 81-0, third 17 Sept 2024 84-0, signed 3 Oct 2024; Georgian title: ojakhuri ghirebulebebisa da arasrults'lovanis datsvis shesakheb; No URL visible

leads.title: European Court of Human Rights application - Identoba and march participants v. Georgia
leads.documents: Claims Georgia failed to effectively protect 17 May 2012 IDAHOT march participants and failed to investigate/punish perpetrators after police intervened only after fighting and arrested victims.
leads.detail: Filed 14 Jan 2013 by LGBTQ organization Identoba (identoba); Amnesty International also criticized failure to protect; No URL visible

leads.title: Women's Initiatives Supporting Group (WISG) - 'From Prejudice To Equality: study of societal attitudes, knowledge and information regarding the LGBT community and their rights' (2012)
leads.documents: Documents discrimination/violence: 32% experienced physical violence, 89.93% psychological violence; 73% of physical-violence victims never reported to police due to ineffectiveness/fear of homophobic treatment.
leads.detail: 2012 study, 134 respondents for psychological violence, 48 for physical violence, 6 respondents age 16-18; No URL visible

leads.title: Georgian Ombudsman call April 2018 citing Oliari and Others v. Italy + European Convention on Human Rights
leads.documents: Urges government to allow civil partnerships for same-sex couples; argues non-recognition violates ECHR and criticizes constitutional same-sex marriage ban as increasing hatred.
leads.detail: Cites Oliari and Others v. Italy; call for same-sex civil partnerships April 2017-2018 by human rights organizations and Ombudsman; No URL visible
